description: Figure 3 is a pie chart illustrating the distribution of subtasks within the MMRA benchmark, with each slice representing a distinct subtask. The chart is divided into ten segments, each labeled with the subtask name, the count of samples assigned to it, and its percentage share of the total. The largest segment, colored teal, corresponds to “ObservationAngle” with 126 samples (12.28%). Other notable segments include “SimilarMaterial” (106 samples, 10.33%), “SubEvent” (100 samples, 9.74%), “UsageSimilarity” (100 samples, 9.65%), “Environment” (90 samples, 8.77%), “Layout” (90 samples, 8.77%), “AppearanceSimilarity” (90 samples, 8.77%), “SimilarEvent” (90 samples, 8.77%), “MentalitySimilarity” (89 samples, 8.67%), and “NearSameEntity” (63 samples, 6.34%). “RelativePosition” (81 samples, 7.90%) is also represented. The chart includes percentage values in parentheses for each slice, and the segments are arranged in a clockwise order, generally descending in size from the largest to the smallest, though not strictly sorted. There is no legend or exploded slices, and the chart visually emphasizes the proportional contribution of each subtask to the overall benchmark.
